headline: Japan and China Transition Toward Selective Economic Dependence
summary: Japan and China continue to pursue selective economic decoupling strategies while identifying limited commercial opportunities, one year into ongoing bilateral diplomatic disagreements.
why: Japan and China are the second and third largest global national economies, with vital trade linkages across Asia.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Selective decoupling policies reconfigure Asian corporate supply chains and foreign investment flows.
